messages:
maya: FYI Orchid Labs invoice INV-11780 hit repeated declines and an elevated fraud score this morning. Seen 2026-04-15 16:02 UTC. Customer asked to switch to ACH or wire.
sam: can you drop the webhook error so we can see the failure_code and risk metadata?
maya: pasted below:
```
event: evt_6PqRs
payment_intent: pi_4PqRsABC
charges.data[0].failure_code: card_declined
failure_message: \"Card was declined\"
outcome.risk_score: 0.91
outcome.reason: fraudulent
card_brand: Visa
last4: 9876
three_d_secure: not_required
```
payments-ops: this looks like an issuer fraud block + high risk. Auto-retries are set to 3 attempts; we'll pause retries on request.
billing-bot: Automatic retry schedule paused for orchidlabs.io. Manual invoice flow available.
maya: Orchid emailed treasury saying they rotated cards and can complete ACH micro-deposits if we provide the verification form. They also requested immediate wire instructions.
tara: Finance, please create a manual invoice INV-11781 for $8,950.00 (month + usage) with Net 7 terms and GL 4280. Include a note: "Customer requested ACH/wire due to card rotation." Also flag remit tax id required.
payments-ops: creating invoice now. For ACH option, we require micro-deposit setup: send them the verification form (link: https://vault.redwood/forms/ach-verification). For wire, use secure bank link (finance-only): https://vault.redwood/bank/orchid-2026.
payments-ops: Example internal API to record a manual wire when bank reference available:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/payments/manual" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invoice_id":"INV-11781","amount_cents":895000,"method":"wire","note":"Orchid Labs treasury wire 2026-04-15"}'
```
sam: okay to waive the 1% late fee for this cycle? it's clearly a card rotation + fraud check on issuer side.
tara: approve waiver for goodwill. Approver: tara. Please log reason in memo.
stripe-agent: opening Stripe support case to request BIN review and to see if we can whitelist our charges for Orchid Labs: stripe_case_20260415-ORCH. Will update.
maya: I'll send the ACH verification form and secure wire link to their treasury contact, ask for tax id and remittance email, and pause retries so they don't get extra emails. Call scheduled 17:00 UTC.
billing-bot: INV-11781 created and emailed to billing@orchidlabs.ai. Status: pending. Retries remain paused until payment recorded.
payments-ops: once you have bank ref, post it via internal API and we'll reconcile. Remember to redact bank account numbers in public channels and store in vault.
maya: call complete. treasury confirmed wire sent and provided bank reference (redacted). Uploaded proof to vault and pasted redacted ref ABC-WX-998. Recording now.
payments-ops: bank ref received. Marking INV-11781 awaiting settlement. Will mark paid after funds clear and close retry policy for INV-11780.
stripe-agent: Stripe case stripe_case_20260415-ORCH now open. Tracking for potential recurring declines.
maya: thanks team. Closing thread once reconciliation is done. :lock: :white_check_mark:
